Question
========
Which of the following statements best reflects the ASA’s guidance on interpreting p-values?


Answerlist
----------

* P-values are influenced by sample size and measurement precision, and do not reflect effect size or importance.

* A small p-value always indicates a large and important effect.

* A large p-value proves that no effect exists.

* P-values measure the scientific or economic significance of a result.
